@ellieokwilson I am so sorry that this happened to you. Being raped by people we trust is the ultimate betrayal. I am so gladdened by your victory as so few women ever get justice in the rape culture we ALL live in everywhere. My rapist was locked up, too. May they ALL be jailed!
#MeToo

@emma__jayne14 Thank you for choosing Life when you felt your worst and life was he worst for you. 
Thank you for sharing your story.
I DID take all of the actions. God had another plans and then I agreed with a higher purpose for me staying on Earth.
I have learned to love my life.
#MeToo
